jobs.description:
You will be a member of the SEM/TEM team. This team is responsible for in-line and out-of-line released electron microscopy inspection.  As a TEM technician you ensure the smooth processing of the various TEM inspections, focusing on the quality of the inspection. 

As SEM/TEM technician you will have the following key responsibilities: 

• You follow-up the inline TEM queue.
• You adjust released recipes for automated TEM inspections.
• You are responsible for (semi)-automated and guided TEM inspections.
• You contribute to achieving targets.
• You help with statistical process control (SPC) on TEM tools. 

• Preferable you have a bachelor’s degree or associate degree (2-year program) in science (chemistry, biology, physics) or equal to experience.
• It would be a great plus if you have hands-on experience with automated metrology or SEM/TEM inspections in the semi-conductor industry.  
• You are a strong planner and you would enjoy working in a fast-paced environment. You certainly know how to multi-task and prioritize assignments.  
• You are a communicative team player with a very good knowledge of both English and Dutch.
• You are prepared to work in a shift system (early/late/night and 1 weekend out of 4).

jobs.occupation: Researcher - PhD Candidate in Political Economy / International Relations (FRACTURE) M/W/X
jobs.description:
MAIN TASKS

• Conduct doctoral research in international relations, defence policy and international security.
• Develop the theoretical framework of the project, including an extensive review of the literature on alliances, strategic alignment, great-power competition and cooperation among revisionist powers.
• Collect, structure and analyse quantitative and qualitative data concerning the relations among China, Russia, Iran and North Korea.
• Develop a dataset covering cooperation in several domains, including economic, diplomatic, military and technological relations.
• Apply network analysis techniques to map and analyse the structure and evolution of cooperation among the four states.
• Produce network visualisations and quantitative indicators identifying patterns, central actors and asymmetries.
• Conduct qualitative and comparative case studies of episodes of cooperation, competition and geopolitical tension.
• Analyse the political, economic and strategic drivers of cooperation as well as structural asymmetries, dependencies and potential vulnerabilities.
• Contribute to scientific publications, working papers, policy briefs, blog posts and other dissemination outputs.
• Present research results at international academic conferences, RMA seminars and Defence-oriented events.
• Contribute to the activities of relevant academic and institutional research networks, including NATO-related research activities.
• Support knowledge transfer between academic research and Belgian Defence stakeholders.v 
SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

Degree required / ideal degree:

Master's degree in Economics, Political Economy, International Relations, Political Science, or a related field.

This position is open to junior or early-career researchers (0-3 years of experience).

The position is intended for a researcher interested in pursuing a PhD trajectory within the framework of the FRACTURE project.

 

MUST HAVE

• Strong background in political economy, international relations, or related fields 
• Ability to analyse complex geopolitical and international security issues.
• Strong analytical and academic writing skills.
• Ability and motivation to conduct independent scientific research.
• Interest in both quantitative and qualitative research methods.
 

NICE TO HAVE

• Experience with network analysis / data analysis tools (e.g. R, Python, Gephi, etc.) 
• Knowledge of the foreign and security policies of China, Russia, Iran and/or North Korea.
• Familiarity with alliance theory, strategic studies or defence policy.
• Experience working with international economic, diplomatic or security-related datasets.
• Experience with qualitative case-study research.
• Experience with policy-oriented or Defence-related research.
• Experience writing policy briefs or communicating research to non-academic audiences.
 

PERSONAL SKILLS

• Ability to work independently in a multidisciplinary research environment 
• Analytical, critical, and creative thinking 
• Clear and effective communication (oral and written) 
• Proactive, organized, and result-oriented 
• Strong team spirit and collaboration skills 
• High level of integrity and confidentiality
 

OTHER SKILLS

• Excellent command of English (oral and written) 
• Knowledge of French and/or Dutch is an asset 
 

SPECIFIC REQUIREMENTS

• The researcher may be exposed to classified information and will therefore have to obtain the required security clearance. The candidate must consent with the background check required to obtain this clearance, which will be executed by Belgian Defence.
• Working for the Patrimony requires living in Belgium for the duration of the study.

Job Description:

As a Future Finance Talents Internship (FFTI) participant, you will be working alongside experienced finance professionals, contributing to various financial projects and gaining insights into the financial operations of a leading global brewing company. You will play a key role in delivering the main financial products of a Fast Moving Consumer Goods company that impact the company's performance. In 2025, FFTIs converted into full time hires and graduate trainees.

These work experiences will be located in Leuven.

Finance Areas You Could Be Matched With:

• Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A): Our Belgium, BNFL, and Zone Europe HQ hosts a high-performance FP&A team responsible for budgeting, forecasting, and enabling dynamic resource allocation to help deliver our operational and financial objectives.
• Accounting: We deliver a robust, timely set of financials on a monthly basis. Connect across our European Zone to help us manage by exception and automate our monthly and quarterly routines.
• Internal Audit: Jump into the beating heart of an on-going process or financial audit with our Global Risk Management team. Learn how the world's largest brewer runs from the inside out.
• Treasury: Work with our Global Treasury team based in Leuven to understand how we manage our derivatives, cash, and loan portfolio.
In all roles:

• Work-Experience Cohort: Our Future Finance Talent Internships are connected with one another to help create a strong network of young professionals. You will be integrated into operating teams and will therefore be able to leverage from operating team's experience.
• Weekly Masterclass: Regardless of your work-experience area, receive a master-class training from the functional lead of each area to ensure a broad-based understanding of Finance in a Fast Moving Consumer Goods company. (FP&A, Control, Tax, Sales Finance, M&A, Internal Audit, General Management)
• Capstone in Leuven: We will regroup as a full Cohort in Leuven to further cement learnings and ensure a strong network.
Skill-sets you will acquire:

• Data Management: Work with large data sets and support in improving financial reporting systems, ensuring data accuracy and reliability.
• Process Improvement: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to optimize financial processes and ensure best practices in reporting and analysis.
• Cost & Margin Analysis: Analyze production costs, profitability, and gross margins to provide actionable insights.
• Ad Hoc Projects: Participate in various financial projects, including internal audits, cost optimization initiatives, or strategy development.
• Collaboration: Work closely with finance teams in other departments (e.g., operations, marketing, sales) to gather data and insights relevant to financial performance. 
Who We're Looking For:

• Education: Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field. You should be interning before your final year of studies.
• Timing: Academic year Summer 2027
• Languages: you are Fluent in Dutch and/or French and have a good knowledge of English. Other languages are a plus!
• Work Authorization: You are eligible to work in Belgium without the need of a work-permit.
• Skills:
• Strong analytical and quantitative skills.
• Proficiency in process mapping or financial modeling.
•  Good communication skills, both written and verbal.
• Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
• Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills.
Experience:

• Previous internship in finance or accounting is an advantage but not mandatory.
• FFTI is an academic component of your education and is considered an unpaid work experience.

#Talent 

 

Launch Your Career with AB InBev: Graduate Management Trainee Program 

 

What is it? 

 

Our Graduate Management Trainee (GMT) programme is a  

• 10 months program starting in August 2027 
• 3-4-month rotations within the program 
• As a junior talent, you will work on real business projects situated in Sales, Commercial, Supply & Logistics 
• You will have a 70-20-10 learning and development approach, where 70% Learning on the Job, 20% Exposure to Other, 10% Formal Learning & Training 
Who are we looking for? 

 

You are willing to become a future leader within AB InBev, and should be comfortable with an ambiguous career track, and expect geographic mobility. The following qualities describe you: Leader. Proud Owner. Agile Learner. Collaborator. Future Maker. 

 To be eligible: 

• You must have graduated (before September 2027 and no more than two years prior) with a Bachelor's, Master's (or equivalent) degree. 
• You should also have no more than 2 years of professional experience (internships/volunteers/student jobs not included). 
• Your passion and ownership are more important than the subject you studied. 
• Fluent English is needed, as well as the native language of the country you are applying in. 
• A valid permanent visa/work permit is required in the country of application to be eligible for the programme. 
• During the 10-month program and beyond, you might be required to travel within your country of application and across Europe. 
 

We are looking for: Junior talent. Recent Graduate. Junior Manager. Professional Trainee. Graduate Trainee.

• There is no need to upload a cover letter - this will not affect your application. 
 

Good to know 

 

• Our Graduate Management Trainee Programme is the first step to an amazing career at AB InBev. 
• Post-Programme, you will pursue a rewarding career, often within our core functions at the heart of our business within Sales, Commercial, Supply & Logistics. 
• GMT programme will give you valuable exposure and insights into leading and transforming a successful global business. You will work on real projects with senior stakeholders to drive value and undertake a structured program to support your development as a future leader. 
 

What do we offer? 

 

Next to a competitive base salary, we put our people first by providing additional benefits:

• A Flexible Rewards system - (smartphone, bike lease, Extra pension Plan, etc.)

jobs.occupation: Fit-Out Project Manager | Workplace Design & Build M/V/X
jobs.description:
Join our team!
Space Refinery is looking for an experienced Fit-Out Project Manager to join our international team of workspace designers and builders.

We design and build people-centered workplaces for companies across Belgium. Our spaces support innovation, collaboration, and the real needs of the people who use them.

We're looking for someone who brings the same care, ambition, and attention to detail to the execution of our projects.

If you love turning great designs into beautifully executed spaces, enjoy bringing structure to complexity, and get satisfaction from delivering projects that make people happy, we'd love to meet you!
What this role is about
You'll take ownership of office fit-out projects from preliminary budgeting and construction preparation through to successful handover, ensuring they're delivered safely, on time, on budget, and to the quality our clients expect.

You'll work closely with our in-house design-and-build teams, contractors, suppliers, and clients, with the autonomy to lead your projects while benefiting from the support of a collaborative team.
What you'll be in charge of
• Own your projects: Lead office fit-out projects from preparation and procurement through site execution and handover.
• Coordinate people and priorities: Bring contractors, suppliers, and internal teammates together around clear responsibilities, deadlines, and deliverables.
• Control planning and budgets: Proactively manage schedules, costs, change requests, and financial risks to keep projects commercially healthy.
• Build client confidence by Communicating clearly, managing expectations, and creating a smooth, professional project experience.
• Stay ahead of challenges: Identify risks early, explore solutions, and take action before issues escalate.
• Deliver quality: Maintain high standards of workmanship, site safety, and attention to detail.
• Help us get better: Contribute ideas and improvements to how we plan, coordinate, and deliver our projects. What we're looking for
We're looking for a confident, hands-on project manager who combines technical understanding with strong organization, sound judgment, and a proactive mindset.

You don't need to know everything about our way of working from day one, but you should bring the experience and independence to take real ownership of project delivery.

• Proven experience managing construction, renovation, or interior fit-out projects, ideally in commercial or workplace environments.
• Strong technical understanding of construction processes, interior works, and site coordination.
• Confident in managing project budgets, planning, and contractors and suppliers.
• A proactive, solution-oriented approach: you anticipate challenges rather than simply react to them.
• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to build client trust and collaborate across teams.
• A structured and organized way of working, even when things get complex or move fast.
• Fluency in English, with working proficiency in Dutch and/or French.
• 
A valid B driving license and authorization to work in Belgium.

Most importantly, you take pride in your work, care about the people you work with, and genuinely enjoy seeing great projects come to life.

Please note: Candidates must be based in Belgium and legally authorized to work here.

Space Refinery is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive, regardless of background or identity.
 Why join Space Refinery?
• We're an international team of creatives and construction experts based in Brussels, on a mission to create a better world, one workspace at a time.
• We're growing our build capabilities and taking on exciting, increasingly ambitious projects. You'll have the opportunity to make a real impact, bring your ideas to the table, and help shape how we deliver exceptional workplaces.
• What you can look forward to:
• 🌍 An international, talented team of people who care about good design, great execution, and each other.
• 💪 Real ownership and autonomy, with the trust to lead your projects and the support to succeed.
• 🚀 Exciting, varied projects where you can see the tangible impact of your work.
• 🤝 Close design & build collaboration, bringing creative ideas and technical execution together under one roof.
• 🤓 Continuous learning and growth, through knowledge sharing, coaching, and opportunities to develop.
• 🙌 A flexible, collaborative work culture built on trust, accountability, and positive team spirit.
